card.name: Last letters inside capital-letter acronyms
card.fires_on: A capital letter partway through or ending an uppercase acronym, often the final letter just before a closing parenthesis or hyphen. Seen in abbreviations like CDFG, KBDI, LDRD, DSSS and MDRD.

modes.label: Acronym in parentheses
modes.description: Final letter of an abbreviation placed in brackets after its spelled-out name.

modes.label: Acronym used as a short name
modes.description: Later letter of an acronym or call-sign used on its own in running text.
modes.example: known as the Keetch-Byram Drought Index or KBD<<I>>.

modes.label: Letters in a web address
modes.description: A single letter inside a URL path segment that looks like an acronym.

card.plain: It lights up on the later letters of all-capital abbreviations, such as the last D in LDRD.
